cat >> db/schema.ts <<'EOF'

export const comments = sqliteTable('comments', {
  id: integer('id').primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
  postId: integer('post_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  userId: integer('user_id')
    .notNull()
    .references(() => users.id),
  body: text('body').notNull(),
  createdAt: text('created_at').notNull().$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
})

export const commentReports = sqliteTable(
  'comment_reports',
  {
    id: integer('id').primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
    commentId: integer('comment_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => comments.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
    userId: integer('user_id')
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id),
    createdAt: text('created_at').notNull().$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
  },
  (table) => [unique('comment_reports_comment_user_unique').on(table.commentId, table.userId)],
)
EOF
sed -i '' "1s/.*/import { sqliteTable, integer, text, unique } from '@guren\/orm\/drizzle\/sqlite'/" db/schema.ts
bunx guren make:migration comments 2>&1 | tail -5; ls db/migrations; cat db/migrations/*comments*/migration.sql

result:
Comments, deleting, reporting and auto-hiding are in, and `bunx guren gate` passes (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit, tests). The Show page changes are not exercised by any test, and I did not boot the app.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` and `comment_reports`. `comment_reports` has a unique (`comment_id`, `user_id`) constraint. The migration is `db/migrations/20260929145728_comments`.
- **Models:** `app/Models/Comment.ts` holds `Comment` and `CommentReport`, plus `COMMENT_HIDE_THRESHOLD = 3`.
- **Endpoints:** `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts` handles the three endpoints, and `routes/web.ts` puts them behind the `auth` middleware, so a guest is redirected to `/login`.
  - `POST /posts/:id/comments` validates the body as 1–2000 characters. It is trimmed, like the post title, so a whitespace-only comment is rejected.
  - `DELETE /comments/:id` is allowed for the comment's author or the post's author. Anyone else gets 403.
  - `POST /comments/:id/report` returns 204 every time and stores one row per user.
- **Post page:** `PostController.show` now passes `comments`, oldest first, as `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`. A comment with three or more distinct reporters is left out of the array but stays in the table.
- **Post deletion:** `PostController.destroy` removes the post's comments and their reports explicitly, in addition to the `ON DELETE CASCADE` on the tables. I did this because cascades only work if SQLite foreign keys are switched on, and I didn't check that.
- **UI:** `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` lists the comments and adds a comment box for signed-in users. Delete appears only where the viewer may use it, and Report is shown to all signed-in users. Guests see a "Sign in to comment" link.
- **Tests:** `tests/CommentController.test.ts` covers the guest redirect, validation, delete permissions, report deduplication and hiding, and deletion with the post.

Reporting a comment that doesn't exist returns 404 rather than 204.

The Report button posts through Inertia and gets a 204 back. I haven't seen how Inertia handles that in a browser, so try that button first.
